market_summary: During the London/NY Overlap, market dynamics are led by sharp risk-off expansion in equities, where US100 triggered a high-volume breakdown below its Value Area Low and Gamma Flip into a Negative Amplifying GEX regime, opening substantial downside room toward Put Wall #1. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and EURUSD are consolidating inside their respective session Value Areas, respecting resistance around their falling VWAPs and EMA50s. GBPUSD attempted a high-RVOL breakout above VAH but is stalling directly into overhead S/R with delta divergence. BTCUSD remains range-bound within value following an upper-wick rejection at session VWAP.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3880.74 to VAH 3905.89) and currently above POC 3895.33. CVD label is BEARISH (-3.76) with a positive slope (+1.41), diverging from the recent upward push. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is testing session VWAP (3897.90) from below while holding just above EMA50 (3894.60). Candles are mid-channel within the ATR envelope (3872.91 - 3908.06). Volume is grey with RVOL at 1.90, failing to print a fresh yellow spike >2.0. Price is held below VWAP resistance and above S/R support at 3887.45 and Session Low at 3872.70, far below Session High 3922.99. GEX is null. Ranging inside VA around VWAP warrants a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / hovering near session VWAP after rebound
signals.level_event: rejection at VWAP 3897.90 after holding S/R 3887.45

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10518 to VAH 1.10637) and below POC 1.10598. CVD label is NEUTRAL (-673) with a steep negative slope (-2408.64) showing persistent selling pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is below VWAP (1.10571) and EMA50 (1.10560), struggling around the EMA20 baseline (1.10533). Candles are positioned mid-channel between the ATR bounds (1.10400 - 1.10666). RVOL is normal at 1.867 without a yellow spike. Price remains capped by overhead S/R levels at 1.10543 and 1.10574, while holding above Session Low 1.10429 and Prev Low 1.10457. GEX is null. Compression inside the Value Area below VWAP mandates a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / consolidating below VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading above VAH (1.32374) and above POC (1.32338). CVD is NEUTRAL (+965) but displaying a negative slope (-970.19), diverging from the bullish expansion bar. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is above VWAP (1.32324) and EMA50 (1.32324). Candles are reaching toward the upper ATR band (1.32474). The breakout bar was confirmed by a yellow RVOL spike of 2.126. However, price is immediately encountering overhead S/R resistance at 1.32431 below Session High 1.32503 without CVD confirmation. GEX is null. Due to immediate resistance confluence and fading delta, action is HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish / breaking above session VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (28208.53) and below POC (28260.78). CVD label is NEUTRAL (-1.30) with an accelerating negative slope (-2.87) confirming sharp selling pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price suffered a severe structural break below VWAP (28309.50) and EMA50 (28290.85). The candle is puncturing below the lower ATR band (28162.87) in a volatility expansion. RVOL printed 2.156, a rare and highly significant yellow spike on Dukascopy US100 confirming institutional liquidation. Price broke through Session Low 28112.06. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip 28308.35 where dealer hedging accelerates downward trend flushes; Put Wall #1 sits at 27999.34, leaving over 113 points of room to scalp ahead of major dealer support and S/R 28030.00.

signals.level_event: breakdown below VAL 28208.53 and Session Low 28112.06
